paragraphs: Rav Menashya bar Taḥlifa studied halakhah, Sifra and Sifrei, yet Rami bar Ḥama did not include him in the zimmun. Rava said Rami bar Ḥama died only because he did not include him, Sheloshah She'Akhelu 47b. He said: Rav said, there 49b; in Rav's name, Pesaḥim 6b. She'erit Yosef lists him among Rav's students, but he appears to have lived in Rava's time (see Rabbah bar Taḥlifa and Huna bar Taḥlifa). R. Amram said: Rabbah bar bar Ḥana said: They asked R. Elazar ben Pedat, Yoma 78. Perhaps Rav Huna, R. Yirmeyah and Rabbah were his brothers.
